stick.name: stick
stick.desc: Light and useful; the start of many tools.

stone.name: stone
stone.desc: Hard and heavy; good for tools, fire rings and building.

flint.name: flint
flint.desc: A stone that breaks into sharp edges.

plant_fiber.name: plant fiber
plant_fiber.desc: Tough grass strands that can be twisted together.

rope.name: rope
rope.desc: Ties things together; many tools need it.

campfire.name: campfire
campfire.desc: Place it to make light and warmth, and to cook on.

stone_knife.name: stone knife
stone_knife.desc: Sharp. Cuts grass into twice as much fiber, and sometimes finds seeds while doing it.

stone_axe.name: stone axe
stone_axe.desc: Chops trees for whole logs, not just sticks.

stone_pickaxe.name: stone pickaxe
stone_pickaxe.desc: Breaks streaked rocks to get ore.

workbench.name: workbench
workbench.desc: Place it; many finer things can only be made near one.

sign.name: sign
sign.desc: Place it, then write on it so others can read your words.

wooden_wall.name: wooden wall
wooden_wall.desc: Place walls to shape rooms and homes.

chest.name: chest
chest.desc: Set it down, then anyone can store things in it or take things out.

charcoal.name: charcoal
charcoal.desc: Burns very hot; a furnace wants it.

brick.name: brick
brick.desc: Fired clay; strong for building ovens and furnaces.

furnace.name: furnace
furnace.desc: Place it near a workbench; it can melt ore into metal.

copper_wire.name: copper wire
copper_wire.desc: Thin metal thread; strange machines are made of it.

book.name: book
book.desc: Bound pages to keep knowledge in.

terminal.name: terminal
terminal.desc: A thinking machine. Program it with Lua.

wheat_seeds.name: wheat seeds
wheat_seeds.desc: Plant them in soil and they grow into wheat. A poor meal in a pinch.

wheat.name: wheat
wheat.desc: Golden stalks. Ground up, they become flour.

flour.name: flour
flour.desc: Baked by a fire, it becomes bread.

hoe.name: hoe
hoe.desc: Lets you plant seeds and berries in the ground.

bed.name: bed
bed.desc: Place it; resting beside a bed restores energy much faster.

door.name: door
door.desc: Place it in a wall so you can walk through.

fishing_rod.name: fishing rod
fishing_rod.desc: Lets you catch fish when you gather beside water.

fish.name: fish
fish.desc: Edible raw, much better cooked over a fire.

wool.name: wool
wool.desc: Soft fibers; can be woven into cloth.

cloth.name: cloth
cloth.desc: Woven fabric for beds and clothes.

carrot_seeds.name: carrot seeds
carrot_seeds.desc: Plant them in soil and they grow into carrots. A poor meal in a pinch.

basket.name: basket
basket.desc: Set it down, then anyone can store things in it or take things out: a shared store.
